title: Persisted Timeline export
donor_inventory: Full per-task source attribution remains in #647 docs/plans/pr612-split/tasks.json, sections.json and net-diff.json. These are reference paths, not a cherry-pick or an instruction to import generic native controls.
implementation: Export the entire committed canonical Timeline snapshot to readable Markdown/HTML, selected as all saved Timeline or conversation content (user/assistant messages and voice transcripts). Paginate canonical persisted entries and progress until complete, fail explicitly at bounds, reuse existing typed projection, and deliver an authenticated single-use client download through existing Files/direct/relay managers. No provider invocation, prompt, restore, writer, native export gateway or source journal mutation.
acceptance: Actual saved files match persisted Timeline selection, readable message/card rendering and inert HTML escaping. The full saved scope is not a UI page. Active native execution remains running with no extra input/writer/interruption. Old hosts receive no unsupported request. Downloads require receipt-consistent bytes, bounded resources, cancellation and cleanup; missing artifacts are not re-exported automatically.
base_update: Fast-forward inherited task04's metadata-only ADR238 proposed-status follow-up; no functional dependency change.

interface_changes.old: No Ait persisted-Timeline export RPC or SDK operation.
interface_changes.new: Typed agent.timeline.export.request and agent.timeline.export.cancel.request, typed artifact receipt, exportAgentTimeline/cancelAgentTimelineExport, negotiated agentTimelineExport capability requiring both methods.
interface_changes.migration: Additive wire/SDK feature; old hosts are gated before request and old clients keep existing Timeline/messages. No native OMP export or generic action gateway.

interface_changes.old: Provider completion handled existing cross-service work; Files grants addressed existing files.
interface_changes.new: Typed Completion variants hand an owned GeneratedArtifact to API; existing Files registry also owns generated readers with single-use grants, visitor binding, expiry and bounded slots.
interface_changes.migration: Internal exhaustive Completion consumers are migrated in API. No second token registry or reverse feature-crate dependency. Existing file grant/reader ownership and authorization remain; the narrow browser HTTP CORS extension is disclosed separately.

interface_changes.old: The existing tokenized file download lacked browser CORS; only browser-ticket exchange declared it.
interface_changes.new: Validated-origin GET and OPTIONS /api/files/download return precise CORS with GET and Authorization only; preflight bypasses grant consumption.
interface_changes.migration: ADR239 explicitly amends ADR049. No wildcard/cookies/credential relaxation, other route exception or visitor-binding change. Rejected origins never redeem tokens; consumed/missing grants retain existing 403 behavior.

interface_changes.old: Context details and generic direct/relay download managers.
interface_changes.new: Discoverable MD/HTML/scope controls; optional direct target and size constraints on existing desktop download preparation; cancellation/bounds on existing relay helpers; browser_handoff distinguishes browser handoff from an observed disk save.
interface_changes.migration: Actual export callers provide maxBytes and expectedSize; ordinary download callers retain defaults. All transfer paths bind EOF to the typed receipt size. Native cancellation removes only paths this export created or moved. All nine locales contain the new labels. No new editor or provider-specific controls.
